MEET THE ARTIST / 한로로

HANRORO

HANRORO is a Korean singer-songwriter who debuted in 2022 with “Let Me Love My Youth” (입춘). Her rock songs give voice to the fears and hopes of growing up, reaching out to others facing the same uncertainty.

Follow via RSS ↗

ROCK / 2023

Even if you leave자처

Official audio

View release on Apple Music ↗

Written and composed by HANRORO, “Even if you leave” (자처) was released in April 2023. The song reflects on attachment and self-blame, and the slow work of carrying on after something has ended.

Listening note

In her release notes, HANRORO describes the difficulty of separating yourself from what holds you back: a relationship, a choice or your own self-blame. The song looks toward accepting what has gone and moving through one day at a time.
